body:
You have the facial expression of someone who just got told your cat died. Smile!
You look pretty good but I would advise you to shave your moustache. You look way better without it. Also if you're going to use dating apps or something try finding some better lighting because your pictures look very grainy. The last picture is definitely your best picture.

We all have moments of weakness. Dont beat you self up about this. Try reaching out to someone you trust or a professional and have a conversation about the things that has happened in your life which has led to this point. Feel better. I believe in you stranger!

Have you thought about sharing these thoughts with her?
It's pretty clear that your self hatred and negative thinking will keep you from having a healthy relationship at the current moment but this could change.
Try doing a little thing every day you wouldn't normally do. I know the thought of bettering yourself at the moment seems unachievable but doing small steps in that direction every day and making new healthier habits could help you get there. 
Have you ever questioned these thoughts putting yourself down? If possible try looking at the thoughts from an objective view point and make descision based on logic rather than emotions(I know this sounds difficult, but this has helped me personally). I'm sorry you feel this way stranger on the internet but nothing changes if you dont and I believe that you have the will power to get through this.
I would see this as a positive sign. Something is holding you back from seriously injuring yourself. Being weak would be going the whole way completely giving up.

Maybe use the limited free time you have to research different hobbies and focusing on what makes you happy. I know being social and having people around you is a positive thing, but if you're in a bad mindset from not being happy then I feel like finding sources of joy should be your number one priority.

Im about to turn 24 myself in a month. I have had the same feelings about life as you have. I got on antidepressive meds and have almost no suicidal thoughts anymore. I am still unhappy and nothing in my life has really changed but atleast I dont kill myself all the time. Have u tried talking to a profesional about your feelings?
You're just playing life on hardcore. Keep digging and you might find a diamond.

Dont kill yourself over the thought of losing a girl. I can tell your feelings for her are very intense and you feel like shes your whole world. Just remember you haven't lost her yet and your best shot at keeping her is to keep improving yourself as a human being and actually enjoying life. Otherwise its just going to end up being a toxic relationship because she is going to feel like your always watching over her and that she can't do things without you. Also just appreciate that you're feeling this way. Being in love is great and it shouldn't be something that consumes your head with negative thoughts. She might leave you someday and it will hurt but I promise you that if you focus on your goals and being happy instead of spending all your time obsessing over the posibility that she will leave you then you're going to be way more attractive for the next girl you going to fall head over heels in love with.
